diagnostic_scope: One matched retention-ranking contrast; no model, training, private reference, replay or cohort benchmark
endpoint_rule: numpy_rint nearest source-axis voxelcount, minimum1; actual physicaladvance reported, may exceed requested1mm
scope: Only retained-frontier ranking changes. Same horizon24, cap120, intermediate1mm, footprintTrue, columns, tools/reward/public arrays, beam2 and all work budgets; global target context off.
